text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back to the dorms already,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It was! It was fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Everyone wanted me to win, and I didn't.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I gotta try even harder and get even
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I have to get first place! Then, everyone
will take
me seriously!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And once everyone takes me seriously,
it'll make
them smile even more when I
win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara really has changed from her
days of
just doing everything for fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She finally has a real hunger for victory.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And... I wanna enter a G1!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
G1 races are a big deal, right? So I
wanna win
one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara has finally found a race goal!
She's
grown more than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a sprint on a dirt course, which is
what she
excels at. I think she has a
great shot at getting
first!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We set our sights on taking first place in
the JBC
Sprint!
